metaTitle: Custom Merchant Craft Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Get custom Merchant Craft school work backpacks for your team. Bulk orders with logo imprinting available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Merchant Craft backpacks are built for daily use, with padded laptop compartments and reinforced stitching that hold up to books, gear, and commuting. When you add your logo through screen printing or embroidery, these bags become walking billboards for your school, business, or organization. Choose from multiple colorways to match your brand palette, and order in bulk for employee gifts, student orientation, or event giveaways.
